integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot of the Costume Workshop late at night, where Sterling stands beside the Tailor's Dress Form holding the restored Captain's Frock Coat. Inside the Costume Workshop late at night, Sterling returns the restored Captain's Frock Coat onto the Tailor's Dress Form. The narrator says: <d>[English] You are finally finished and ready to take the stage.</d> She gently brushes lint off the gold brocade patch. Sterling (S1) adds: <d>[English] Everything is restored down to the finest stitch.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot. She then reaches forward and clicks off the bench lamp. The camera pulls back at slow speed in a wide shot, lingering on Sterling as she stands looking proudly at the restored velvet.

overall_soundscape: The soft rustle of velvet settling over the dress form, followed by a light brushing sound over brocade. A crisp mechanical click sounds as the bench lamp switch is turned off, leaving quiet late-night workshop ambience.
